The codec validates converted UTF-8 through safe Rust APIs and forbids
unsafe code. Encoding and standard CESU-8 behavior are unchanged. The
Java decoder also accepts checked four-byte UTF-8 characters alongside
modified NUL bytes or encoded surrogate pairs.
